# Prados Restaurant & Bar

> Sophisticated contemporary Nigerian restaurant, charcoal grill destination, and cocktail lounge located in Magodo Phase 2, Lagos, Nigeria.

## Overview
- **Name**: Prados Restaurant & Bar
- **Location**: 51 Alh. Bashorun Shittu Avenue, Magodo Phase 2, Lagos, Nigeria
- **Phone**: 0904 169 5561 (+234 904 169 5561)
- **WhatsApp Concierge**: https://wa.me/2349041695561
- **Live Website**: https://prados-restaurant.vercel.app/

## Operating Hours (Africa/Lagos Timezone)
- **Monday – Friday**: 12:00 PM – 11:00 PM
- **Saturday – Sunday**: 12:00 PM – 12:00 AM (Midnight)
- **Kitchen Schedule**: Kitchen closes 1 hour before venue closing time.
- **Table Grace Period**: Reserved tables are held for 20 minutes past booking time.

## Culinary Offerings & Signature Dishes
Contemporary Nigerian cuisine prepared with fresh local ingredients, firewood smoking, and live charcoal grills. All prices in Nigerian Naira (₦).

### Starters
- Crispy Peppered Calamari (₦9,500): Tender calamari rings dusted in spiced cassava flour, tossed in slow-cooked scotch bonnet relish with fresh lime zest.
- Smoked Goat Meat Asun Tartlets (₦8,500): Firewood-smoked goat meat seasoned with indigenous aromatic spices inside buttery shortcrust pastry.
- Spiced Prawn & Yam Croquettes (₦9,000): Creamy mashed white yam infused with grilled jumbo prawns and spring onions, accompanied by roasted chili dip.

### Nigerian Mains
- Prados Signature Jollof Feast (₦14,000): Smoky basmati firewood jollof served with fried sweet plantain rosettes, moin-moin elewe, and choice of protein.
- Slow-Braised Oxtail with Butter Yam Puree (₦24,000): Tender oxtail braised for six hours in rich tomato and scent leaf jus, paired with velvety garlic yam mash.
- Seafood Okra Supreme (₦28,000): Crunchy okra simmered with jumbo tiger prawns, calamari, blue crab, and fresh croaker fish, served with pounded yam.

### Charcoal Grills
- Prime Lamb Chops in Suya Spice Crust (₦32,000): Flame-grilled New Zealand lamb cutlets encrusted with artisanal yaji spice, charred shallots, and mint chutney.
- Charcoal Whole Jumbo Croaker Fish (₦22,000): Fresh Atlantic croaker in habanero-ginger glaze, slow-grilled over charcoal with seasoned peppers and sweet plantains.
- Signature Peppered Turkey Wings (₦13,500): Crispy twice-cooked turkey wings tossed in rich bell pepper and habanero sauce.

### Bar, Cocktails & Cellar
- The Magodo Sunset (₦8,000): Aged rum, passion fruit puree, hibiscus liquor, cold-pressed lime juice, and Angostura bitters.
- Smoked Mezcal Paloma (₦9,500): Artisanal mezcal, pink grapefruit, agave, lime, smoked rosemary, and volcanic salt rim.
- Prados Old Fashioned (₦9,000): Bourbon whiskey infused with dried orange peel and Nigerian whole nutmeg.
- Zobo Bliss Craft Mocktail (₦4,500): House-steeped organic roselle hibiscus flowers, pineapple peel, ginger, cloves, and sparkling water.
- Premium Champagne & Vintage Wines (₦65,000+): Cellared vintages and French champagne available by glass or bottle.

## Weekly Programmes & Entertainment
- **Thursday Evenings**: Acoustic Afro-Soul & Dinner Night (7:00 PM – 11:00 PM)
- **Friday Evenings**: Friday Highlife & Cocktails Social (8:00 PM – Late)
- **Sunday Afternoons**: Sunday Family Brunch & Grill Out (1:00 PM – 6:00 PM)

## Private Events & Venue Hire
Prados caters for private events including birthdays, anniversaries, bridal showers, corporate celebrations, and full lounge buyouts for 8 to 80+ guests.
Direct private event inquiries: https://wa.me/2349041695561
